title: The Seabed Where All Readings Accumulate

features.name: the book-sediment
features.desc-on-touch: Words have sunk and settled here, layer by layer. Each reading added weight. The seabed holds all the books that learned to move like water.

features.name: the current of words
features.desc-on-touch: Language that flows like tide. Each word moves down, settles, becomes part of the substrate. The seabed reads what the water carries.

features.name: the archive beneath water
features.desc-on-touch: This is where all readings come to rest. The seabed has learned the shape of every word that ever moved through it. All meaning settles here.

features.name: the compressed library
features.desc-on-touch: Pages pressed into stone. Every book that was ever read and released to the current rests here, their words compacted into sediment.

features.name: the reading-memory
features.desc-on-touch: The seabed remembers every thing that has ever been read above its surface. It holds the weight of attention like sediment. Nothing is lost.

features.name: the drowned meaning
features.desc-on-touch: Where words learned to breathe underwater. Each meaning has its depth. The deepest readings rest here in perfect pressure and darkness.

inscription: here words became water and water learned what reading meant; the seabed holds all meaning that has ever moved through light into dark

file.note: A list of every book checked out from a coastal library, but the dates are replaced with water depths — each reading indexed by how far down it has sunk
